name: Apartments.com
description: Apartments.com is CoStar's rental marketplace and property-management suite for advertising listings, handling leads, applications and screening, leases, rent payments, maintenance, expenses and integrations.
agentUseSummary: Apartments.com is visible as a provider-partnership security preview. Relay will not connect listing or lead feeds or access renter applications, screening or payments until CoStar approves a least-privilege production integration contract.

capabilities.label: Review bounded Apartments.com partner access
capabilities.description: If CoStar approves a least-privilege partner contract, expose only exact-property, privacy-redacted listing and lead tools after legal and security review.

blocked.label: Capture Apartments.com partner credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not request customer sessions, account passwords, feed credentials, API keys or partner material for this preview.

blocked.label: Read private renter or applicant data
blocked.description: Leads, communications, applications, identity documents, credit and background reports, leases, payment details and maintenance records are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change listings or automate leads
blocked.description: Listing feeds, unit pricing and availability changes, lead routing, tour scheduling, applications and communications are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run screening or payment actions
blocked.description: Relay will not submit renter applications, order or act on consumer reports, create leases, configure payments or initiate financial transactions.

blocked.label: Run Apartments.com actions before security review
blocked.description: No Apartments.com tool is callable until CoStar approves Relay's partner access, exact authentication and scopes, immutable property binding, data-use limits, lifecycle, auditing and distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: Apartments.com partner security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because Apartments.com publishes integrations through approved partners and its rental workflows contain regulated applicant, screening and financial data.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable without an approved Apartments.com partner contract.
No Hermes tools are callable without an approved Apartments.com partner contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Apartments.com advertises listing feeds, Lead API, guest-card, tour-scheduling, application and other integrations through named vendors and directs new vendors to contact CoStar to become a partner. No public self-service authentication, scopes, account and property binding, API schemas, lifecycle, limits, auditing or distribution contract is available. Its terms also restrict third-party sharing of rental applications and prohibit acting for renters on applications, screening and payment transactions.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask CoStar to approve Relay as an Apartments.com production integration partner and provide exact authentication, scopes, immutable customer and property claims, versioned listing and lead schemas, event identifiers, lifecycle, limits, auditing, data-use restrictions and distribution terms. Limit any future V1 to approved property-manager listing and lead workflows; keep rental applications, consumer reports, leases and payments blocked unless CoStar separately authorizes a compliant contract.

evidence.supports: Apartments.com lists named integration partners for listing feeds, Lead API, CRM, guest cards, tour scheduling and applications, and directs prospective vendors to contact it to become a partner.
Apartments.com documents connecting and updating listings through specific third-party property-management and syndication vendors rather than a public self-service API.
Apartments.com's Rental Manager spans listings, messages, applicant screening, leases, rent collection, maintenance and expense tracking.

Apartments.com's rental-service terms restrict sharing applications and consumer-report information with third parties and prohibit submitting applications or initiating screening and payment actions for renters.
CoStar's privacy notice covers Apartments.com account, communication, transaction, financial, identity, geolocation and other personal data, requiring strict minimization and purpose binding.
Apartments.com's general terms restrict automated access and reuse of site materials and do not grant Relay public API or integration rights.
